images.name: petit
images.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Edit the supplied robot concept into a NEW FRONT VIEW for a game garage character selector.
The supplied image is only a CHARACTER IDENTITY / MATERIAL reference. The user's explicit correction is: "de face et ils se ressemblent trop" — FRONT-FACING and MUCH more distinct body designs.
CRITICAL CAMERA: exact straight-on ANTERIOR FRONT view at chest height, near-orthographic, robot facing directly toward viewer. Both eyes visible, front chest clearly visible, both knees and both boot toe caps pointing forward. Symmetrical presentation. Absolutely NO rear view, NO back view, NO three-quarter view, NO elevated isometric camera. The reference is from behind but the requested final picture must be from the FRONT.
Identity anchors: original practical robot made of scratched bone-ivory/cream industrial armor, charcoal exposed mechanical joints, restrained dark steel machinery, and the original deep brick-red cloth cape. Preserve the familial head shape: small rounded oblong mechanical ivory helmet with simple dark inset optics, no human features. Cape attaches behind shoulders and is visible along the sides and behind the legs, never covering the chest. A few dull rust-orange fasteners only. No neon cyan or blue palette.
Pose: full-body neutral garage stance, head to boots visible, relaxed open empty mechanical hands held slightly away from hips, arms spaced from torso. REMOVE the gun entirely to expose the front body silhouette; no weapons, shield or props.
Style: premium detailed stylized 3D game character concept, worn enamel plates, believable robot construction, broad readable forms, subtle realistic material response, soft upper-left key, same style as reference. Do not trace the reference pose.
Canvas: square transparent PNG, entire single robot isolated with clean alpha; no ground, floor, background, cast shadow, circle, pedestal, text, stats, UI, borders, logos or watermark. Feet baseline at 90% canvas height, centered.
Design requirement: three classes of the SAME player robot family, but each with a RADICALLY DISTINCT silhouette and mechanical construction. Identity comes from head, cream metal and red cape, NOT identical body anatomy merely resized. Exactly ONE robot in this image.
Specific variant: SMALL LIGHT SCOUT, quick and fragile. Strong slim triangle/runner silhouette with clearly exposed slender mechanics; 70% less armor mass than the heavy. Small narrow compact chest made of just two thin tapered breastplates, exposed dark waist and hip mechanisms, tiny shoulder caps no wider than head-and-neck assembly, thin rod-like upper arms, light tapered forearm shells, open lightweight hands. Long springlike slender shins relative to the SHORT body, only minimal kneecaps and small streamlined split-toe mechanical feet, narrow hips and clear gaps between limbs. Make it visibly a lightweight precision runner, NOT a small copy of the medium tank. The robot itself is short and narrow, occupies only 61% of canvas height from head to feet and about 26% width. Red cape is a short narrow ragged capelet, reaching only upper thighs, behind the torso. Face directly forward, empty hands, no weapon. Adult purposeful machine, not cute or childlike.
